title: Cross-cloud marketplace launch coordination and post-launch feedback loop
creator: Maya Chen
description: Coordinate final marketplace packaging, listing assets, release notes, and post-launch signals across AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace. This ticket covers go/no-go gating for each vendor portal, centralization of the public release notes, verification of billing/entitlement mappings, and the first 72-hour post-launch monitoring plan to capture telemetry and customer feedback. Workstreams include: seller account handoffs, offer metadata sync, pricing SKU validation, screenshot/localization sign-off, and automated release-note publication to docs and in-product banners.
acceptance_criteria: Each cloud marketplace has a published listing with correct SKU/price, screenshots, and a functioning deployment flow (test purchase or entitlement provisioning validated)
Central release notes page (confluence + docs.redwood.com) contains the marketplace-specific callouts and a consolidated changelog entry
Release notes are delivered to the SDK/CLI teams for in-product banner and telemetry tagging before listing goes live
Monitoring dashboards show health, provisioning failure rate, and first-use latency for new marketplace customers within 72 hours of go-live
At least one post-launch feedback item (bug or UX improvement) is triaged and a follow-up ticket created within 5 business days
tasks: Finalize marketplace-specific copy & screenshots and upload to vendor portals
Run end-to-end entitlement test: create trial offer, provision instance, confirm billing mapping
Publish consolidated release notes and generate marketplace-friendly snippets (150-300 chars) for each portal
Coordinate with Legal for marketplace terms & logos approvals
Create observability dashboard slices in Console (Marketplace channel, acquisition cohort, provisioning-failures)
Prepare rollback checklist and set canary percentage for first 100 seats
Set up customer support playbook for marketplace purchases (email templates, escalation flow)
Confirm marketplace billing reconciliation sample for finance (test invoice and SKU mapping)
updates: 2026-02-22 — Kickoff meeting with Eng, Design, Legal, Finance, and Growth. Agreed to unified release notes canonical source in Confluence. Assigned asset owners: DES-4021 for screenshots, ENG-2145 for entitlement tests.
2026-02-26 — Design delivered final 16:9 and 1:1 tiles; uploaded to drive. Noted Azure requires a 1200x627 hero image (action: DES-4021 to export).

2026-03-01 — Eng completed automated entitlement smoke test script. Test run against staging marketplace connectors showed a 2% provisioning failure (root cause: IAM role timeout). ENG mitigated with retry logic; retest scheduled.
2026-03-03 — Legal approved modified Marketplace terms for AWS and Azure with logo usage caveats. GCP flagged two IP questions; legal following up (ETA 2026-03-06).
2026-03-04 — Draft release notes published to Confluence. Requested PM and DevRel review to produce short marketplace snippets for each portal. Assigned to Ethan for marketplace snippets.

2026-03-05 — Observability tickets created: ENG-3298 (dashboard slices), ENG-3301 (event-tagging for marketplace-acquired users). Added retention: 30 days for detailed trace events for first 72-hour window.
stakeholders: Engineering: Priya Nair (runtime lead), Daniel Kim (marketplace connector)
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (pre-launch) — final verifications in vendor staging portals, screenshots and short snippets uploaded, entitlement smoke tests green
Phase 1 (soft launch) — publish listing to one region per cloud with canary entitlement gating for first 100 seats; monitor 0-72h metrics
Phase 2 (full launch) — increase availability to remaining regions, promote pricing/marketing assets, sync docs and in-product banners
Phase 3 (post-launch) — 14-day monitoring window, collect feedback, prioritize follow-ups into next cycle
rollback_plan: Disable new offer visibility in vendor portal (publisher action)
Flip in-product registry flag to previous fulfillment path (Console toggle)
Send proactive communication to affected customers and support teams
Open hotfix PR for entitlement connector and ship emergency patch if failure rate >5%
post_launch_monitoring: First-use latency distribution for marketplace-acquired users
Support ticket volume and top-3 error buckets
Feature adoption of marketplace-onboarded customers within 7 days
notes_and_risks: Risk: Marketplace-specific metadata requirements differ and may delay publishing (mitigation: per-cloud checklists maintained in Confluence)
Risk: Finance reconciliation lag could create customer confusion; we will validate sample invoices ahead of launch
Note: GCP legal review is the current blocker for GCP listing; priority follow-up by Legal
Note: Consider staggered localization (start with en-US; add localized snippets in subsequent release)
